clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, legal-requirements paragraph; applies to use of the website products and services when Baidu requests information about the true background and purpose of use.
clauses.condition_explanation: provide_truthful_complete_accurate_information_when_baidu_reasonably_requests_it means the user must truthfully provide information that is real, complete, and accurate in response to a request by Baidu based on its stated right to understand the actual background and purpose of use.

obligation_items.content: Provide truthful, complete, and accurate information when Baidu requests information about the actual background and purpose of using the website products or services.
obligation_items.object: Information about the user's use of website products and services
obligation_items.trigger: Baidu requests the information about the actual background and purpose of use.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, user rights and obligations, operating-permit requirement; covers commercial or noncommercial activities conducted using Baidu Cloud services where governmental permission or approval is required.
clauses.condition_explanation: obtain_all_licenses_or_approvals_required_for_the_user_activity means secure each permission or approval required by the relevant authorities for the activity before or while conducting it.

obligation_items.content: Obtain the governmental licenses or approvals required for the activity conducted using the service.
obligation_items.object: The user's commercial or noncommercial activity conducted using Baidu Cloud services
obligation_items.trigger: The activity requires a license or approval from a national authority.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, operating-permit examples; specifically applies when the user operates multiple websites on a cloud server.
clauses.condition_explanation: each_website_operated_on_cloud_server_has_required_governmental_license_or_approval means every website the user operates on the cloud server has obtained the required governmental license or approval.

obligation_items.content: Ensure that every website operated on the cloud server has the licenses or approvals required by national authorities.
obligation_items.object: Each website operated on the cloud server
obligation_items.trigger: The user operates multiple websites on the cloud server.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, operating-permit examples; applies when the user's website provides noncommercial internet information services.
clauses.condition_explanation: noncommercial_internet_information_site_filed_and_filing_information_kept_accurate_and_current means the user completes the required noncommercial website filing, submits true and effective filing information, and timely updates the filing system when that information changes.

obligation_items.content: Complete the required noncommercial website filing and ensure all submitted filing information is true and effective.
obligation_items.object: Filing information for the user's noncommercial internet-information website
obligation_items.trigger: The user's website provides noncommercial internet information services.

obligation_items.content: Timely update the filing system when filing information changes.
obligation_items.object: Filing information for the user's noncommercial internet-information website

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, operating-permit examples; applies when the user's website provides commercial internet information services.
clauses.condition_explanation: commercial_internet_information_site_has_required_local_communications_authority_license means the user obtains the operating website license from the local communications authority.

obligation_items.content: Obtain the operating website license from the local communications authority.
obligation_items.trigger: The user's website provides commercial internet information services.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, operating-permit examples; applies when the user provides BBS or another electronic bulletin-board service.
clauses.condition_explanation: bbs_service_has_filing_or_approval_required_by_applicable_rules means the user completes any filing or obtains any approval required by applicable laws and policies; the source does not say both are invariably required.

obligation_items.content: Complete the filing or obtain the approval required by applicable laws and policies for the electronic bulletin-board service.
obligation_items.object: The user's BBS or other electronic bulletin-board service
obligation_items.trigger: The user provides such a service and applicable laws or policies require filing or approval.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, operating-permit examples; applies when the user operates an internet game website.
clauses.condition_explanation: internet_game_website_has_required_network_culture_business_license means the user obtains the network culture business license required by law.

obligation_items.content: Obtain the network culture business license required by law.
obligation_items.trigger: The user operates an internet game website.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, operating-permit examples; applies when the user operates an internet audio or video website.
clauses.condition_explanation: internet_audio_video_website_has_required_audiovisual_program_license means the user obtains the information-network audiovisual-program dissemination license required by law.

obligation_items.content: Obtain the information-network audiovisual-program dissemination license required by law.
obligation_items.object: The user's internet audio or video website
obligation_items.trigger: The user operates an internet audio or video website.

coverage_notes: The referenced Baidu account-cancellation agreement and its operating instructions are not supplied; their additional terms are not inferred. The locally stated right to stop service and initiate account cancellation is not itself an activity in the fixed vocabulary.

The account-related paragraphs describe Baidu's discretionary powers to unify treatment, restrict or terminate services, and query, freeze, or deduct account-related items at authority request. Those provider actions do not map faithfully to the available activities and are not converted into user prohibitions or permissions.
For the BBS example, the source requires filing or approval as applicable; it does not impose both cumulatively in every case.

paragraph_audit.reason: This paragraph states Baidu's discretionary power to specially treat related accounts, including refusal, restriction, or termination of service and joint liability; those provider powers and account-administration actions have no faithful activity in the fixed vocabulary.

This is one stated basis for the related-account treatment power: accounts with specified relationships have joint liability only as provided by the referenced laws, agreement, product agreements, or rules. It supplies context, not a separate action rule.

This is a stated circumstance supporting unified treatment of accounts, not a user permission or prohibition: the accounts correspond to the same legal entity previously identified as registering maliciously for improper benefit.

This states Baidu's discretionary authority to unify treatment of multiple accounts for other sufficiently justified reasons; that provider account-administration power does not map faithfully to an available activity.

The local duty to provide truthful, complete, and accurate information on Baidu's reasonable request is modeled. The user's right to stop service and initiate account cancellation, and Baidu's powers to restrict account services or query, freeze, or deduct personal information, funds, transactions, or account items at authority request, do not map faithfully to an available activity. The referenced cancellation agreement is not supplied.
The heading is context; the paragraph expressly requires the user to obtain any governmental license or approval required for commercial or noncommercial activity using the service.
Expressly requires required governmental licensing or approval for every website operated on the cloud server.
Expressly requires noncommercial website filing, truthful and effective filing information, and timely filing-system updates when information changes.
Expressly requires the local communications-authority operating license for a commercial internet-information website.
Expressly requires filing or approval for BBS or equivalent electronic bulletin-board service to the extent required by applicable laws and policies.
Expressly requires the legally required network culture business license for an internet game website.
Expressly requires the legally required information-network audiovisual-program dissemination license for an internet audio or video website.
